# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Terminal" label
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 23:28"
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Background
- Geometric abstract design with polygonal shapes
- Color gradient from deep purple to reddish-orange
- Central visual element resembling a stylized feather or abstract form

## Terminal Window
- **Window Title Bar**:
  - Left: Terminal icon (command prompt symbol)
  - Center: User and hostname: "user@user-virtual-machine: ~"
  - Right: Window control buttons (search, menu, minimize, maximize, close)
- **Terminal Content**:
  - Command prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine:~$"
  - Executed command: "grep OPENAI_API_KEY ~/.bashrc"
  - Terminal background: Dark purple
  - Text color: Light green for prompt, white for command
  - Vertical scrollbar on the right side

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome (multicolored circle)
  - Thunderbird (blue bird)
  - Visual Studio Code (blue icon with "VS" letters)
  - VLC Media Player (orange traffic cone)
  - LibreOffice Writer (blue document icon)
  - LibreOffice Calc (green spreadsheet icon)
  - LibreOffice Impress (orange presentation icon)
  - GIMP (gray dog with paintbrush)
  - Files (gray folder icon)
  - Ubuntu Software (orange shopping bag)
  - Help (blue question mark)
  - Terminal (gray terminal icon with ">_" symbol)
  - Trash (green recycling bin)
  - App Grid (3x3 grid of dots)

## Bottom Right Corner
- **Home Folder Icon**:
  - Gray folder with house symbol
  - Label: "Home" below the icon

## Cursor
- White arrow cursor positioned near the center of the desktop, below the terminal window
